boarding_points.name: Cais de Turismo de Paraty
boarding_points.operator: Prefeitura de Paraty (tour-boat licensing); schooner/lancha operators
boarding_points.notes: Main boarding pier for the ~50-schooner and lancha fleet; departures to Ilha dos Cocos, Lagoa Azul, Praia da Lula, Mamanguá and Ilha Grande transfers. Located between Largo da Igreja de Santa Rita and Terra Nova on the historic-center waterfront. Coordinates = OSM named 'Pier' structure (way 293367795), ~350 m east of Igreja de Santa Rita (-23.2204, -44.7134), matching the described location.

boarding_points.name: Cais dos Pescadores (Pier Pescadores)
boarding_points.notes: Fishermen's pier immediately south of the historic center; overflow/secondary small-boat boarding.
boarding_points.source: OSM node 'Pier Pescadores' (tagged marina), lat/lng direct from OSM

boarding_points.name: Marina Porto Imperial
boarding_points.notes: ~200 covered dry berths + 150 wet berths minutes from the historic center — prime charging/berthing backbone. Coordinates = OSM marina way at the site; cross-checked with the marina's helipad node (-23.23088, -44.71548) geocoded by Nominatim.
boarding_points.source: OSM marina way + Nominatim; capacity per https://perfilnautico.com.br/mangaratiba-e-paraty-infraestrutura-ideal-para-os-proprietarios-de-embarcacoes/

boarding_points.name: Marina do Engenho
boarding_points.linked_locale: Paraty (Praia Boa Vista / Rod. Gov. Mário Covas)
boarding_points.notes: Full-service marina on the east side of the Baía de Paraty; charter and private-fleet node.
boarding_points.source: OSM named marina node via Nominatim (Marina do Engenho, Rodovia Governador Mário Covas, Paraty)

boarding_points.name: Paraty Mirim pier/rampa
boarding_points.notes: Boarding point at Paraty Mirim beach — road-accessible launch used by lanchas and taxi-boats toward Mamanguá and the southern coves. Coordinates = OSM pier way at the beach, cross-checked with Nominatim beach feature (-23.2401, -44.6334).
boarding_points.source: OSM pier way at Praia Paraty Mirim + Nominatim

boarding_points.name: Saco do Mamanguá west-shore landing
boarding_points.linked_locale: Saco do Mamanguá (caiçara community, boat-access only)
boarding_points.notes: Unnamed community pier on the west shore of Brazil's only tropical fjord (OSM-mapped structure). Daily shared-lancha tours from Paraty call here; exact preferred landing among the fjord's small piers to be confirmed at survey. Fjord head (Mangue do Mamanguá) is at -23.2940, -44.6409 per Nominatim.
boarding_points.source: OSM pier way inside Saco do Mamanguá; corridor evidence https://rupetour.com.br/passeio-de-barco-3671

boarding_points.name: Laranjeiras pier (Praia do Sono gateway)
boarding_points.notes: Departure point for taxi-boats to Praia do Sono (R$40–60/leg), Antigos and Ponta Negra — the only motorized access to those road-free beaches. Coordinates = OSM ferry_terminal node, corroborated by two adjacent OSM piers (-23.3388/-23.3391, -44.668).
boarding_points.source: OSM ferry_terminal node + piers; access described at https://www.praiadosono.com/comochegar and https://www.grupodicas.com/como-ir-para-a-praia-do-sono-em-paraty/

boarding_points.name: Trindade beach landing (Praia do Meio)
boarding_points.notes: No fixed pier in Trindade — local boats beach-land at Praia do Meio/Praia dos Ranchos for the Cachadaço natural-pool runs. Coordinates = OSM 'Praia do Meio' beach polygon centroid; shallow-draft beach landing, exact ops point to be confirmed at survey.
boarding_points.source: OSM beach relation (Praia do Meio, wikidata Q48884275); tour evidence https://paratymotion.com.br/passeios/tag/trindade

boarding_points.name: Ponta Negra village landing
boarding_points.linked_locale: Ponta Negra (caiçara village, no road access)
boarding_points.notes: Road-free caiçara village on the Juatinga wild coast, served today by taxi-boats from Laranjeiras (~R$120 round trip). Coordinates = OSM node tagged marina at the village.
